cards.en:
An information system is a system of components (data, hardware, software, process and personnel) working together to collect, store, process and output information. It is implemented for automating processes, reducing human errors and improving efficiency.

Example in the book: a library keeps track of the status of its books. Whenever a book is borrowed or returned, the status of the book is updated in the system, so staff and readers can see immediately whether and where it is available. Without the system, staff would have to search shelves or paper records, which is slow and error-prone.

Exam tip: when asked for the purpose / benefit of an information system, quote the three key phrases: automate processes, reduce human errors, improve efficiency, and link each to the scenario.
cards.zh:
资讯系统 (information system) 由多个组成部分（数据、硬件、软件、程序/流程、人员）一起工作，用来收集、储存、处理和输出资讯。设立资讯系统的目的：automating processes, reducing human errors and improving efficiency（流程自动化、减少人为错误、提高效率）。

课本例子：图书馆用资讯系统追踪每本书的状态。书被借出或归还时，系统中的状态会即时更新，职员和读者马上知道书是否可借、放在哪里。没有系统的话要人手翻纸本记录，又慢又容易出错。

考试答题：问资讯系统的目的/好处时，写出三个关键短语 automate processes / reduce human errors / improve efficiency，并结合题目情境解释。

ex.q: A school canteen changes from paper order slips to an online ordering information system. State TWO benefits.
ex.a:
1. Improves efficiency: orders are recorded and totalled automatically, so students queue for less time.
2. Reduces human errors: prices are calculated by the system instead of staff adding by hand, so fewer wrong charges.
ex.az: 两点：提高效率（自动记录和计算订单）；减少人为错误（价钱由系统计算）。

cards.t: Five components of an information system
cards.tz: 资讯系统的五个组成部分
cards.en:
The book lists the components of an information system: Data, Hardware, Software, Process and Personnel.
  • Data: facts stored in storage devices, used by programs for input/output.
  • Hardware: the physical devices.
  • Software: the programs running in the system.
  • Process: the series of steps that determines the order in which data is processed.
  • Personnel: the people who build, run and support the system.
They depend on each other: personnel follow processes, use software running on hardware, to turn data into information. A missing component makes the system fail, e.g. good hardware is useless without software, and a system without trained personnel cannot be maintained.

A common MC trap is a wrong match such as “Personnel: word processor” (a word processor is software, not personnel).
cards.zh:
课本列出资讯系统的组成部分：数据 Data、硬件 Hardware、软件 Software、程序/流程 Process、人员 Personnel。
  • Data：储存在储存装置中、供程序输入/输出的事实。
  • Hardware：实体装置。
  • Software：系统中运行的程序。
  • Process：决定数据处理先后次序的一连串步骤。
  • Personnel：建立、运作和支援系统的人。
各部分互相依赖：人员按流程，使用在硬件上运行的软件，把数据变成资讯。

常见 MC 陷阱：配对错误，例如「Personnel：文书处理软件」是错的，word processor 属于 software。

ex.q: Classify each item into a component: (i) Task Manager (ii) a barcode scanner (iii) the student records of a school (iv) a systems analyst (v) 'the nurse updates the record after the doctor's report'.
ex.a:
(i) Software (utility program)
(ii) Hardware (input device)
(iii) Data
(iv) Personnel
(v) Process
ex.az: 依次为：软件、硬件、数据、人员、流程。

cards.en:
In an information system, data is stored in computer storage devices and used by programs for input or output. It comes in the form of text, images, audios or videos.

Examples from the book: the medical history of a patient stored in a hospital's information system, and the weather data (e.g. satellite views) stored in the Hong Kong Observatory computer system.

STEAM+ note: originally “data” is the plural of “datum”; nowadays “data” is commonly treated as a singular noun (“data is …”).
cards.zh:
在资讯系统中，data is stored in computer storage devices and used by programs for input or output（数据储存在储存装置中，供程序作输入或输出）。形式可以是文字、图像、音频或影片。

课本例子：医院系统中病人的病历；香港天文台电脑系统中储存的天气数据（如卫星图）。

小知识：data 原本是 datum 的复数，现在一般当单数名词使用。

ex.q: Give one example of data in a supermarket information system and state its form.
ex.a: Prices of goods stored in the database (text/numbers); or product photos (images).
ex.az: 例如货品价钱（文字/数字）或货品图片（图像）。

cards.en:
Hardware refers to the physical devices used in an information system for various functions. Table 1.1 groups hardware by function:
FunctionHardware
ProcessingCentral processing unit (CPU)
Connection of system unitsMotherboard
Network communicationHome router, switch, Bluetooth USB dongle
InputKeyboard, microphone, barcode scanner
OutputMonitor, speaker, information panel in a restaurant
Be careful with matching questions: a speaker is output, a keyboard is input, a router/switch is network communication, not processing. (Details of hardware are in Core B.)
cards.zh:
Hardware 指资讯系统中用作不同功能的实体装置。表 1.1 按功能分类：处理 Processing（CPU）；连接系统单元（主机板 motherboard）；网络通讯（家用路由器、交换器 switch、蓝牙 USB 接收器）；输入（键盘、咪高峰、条码扫描器）；输出（显示器、喇叭、餐厅资讯显示屏）。

配对题要小心：喇叭是输出、键盘是输入、路由器/交换器属网络通讯，不是处理。

ex.q: Which pair is correct? A. Input–Speaker B. Processing–Router C. Output–Keyboard D. Network–Switch
ex.a: A switch is used for network communication, so D. Speaker is output, router is network, keyboard is input.
ex.az: 答案 D：switch 用于网络通讯。

cards.tz: 软件：系统软件与应用软件
cards.en:
Software refers to the programs running in an information system. Computers receive commands from these programs to compute.
TypeSub-typeExamples
System softwareOperating systemMicrosoft Windows, macOS (also Android, iOS)
Utility programTask Manager, anti-virus software
Driver programdrivers for a sound card, USB flash drive, printer
Application softwareWord processor, database management software (DBMS), web browser
System software runs and maintains the computer itself; application software lets users do specific tasks. Anti-malware is a utility (system software); Google Chrome is application software.
cards.zh:
Software 指资讯系统中运行的程序，电脑按程序的指令运算。
系统软件 System software：作业系统 OS（Windows、macOS、Android）、公用程序 utility（工作管理员、防毒软件）、驱动程序 driver（声卡、USB 手指、打印机的驱动）。
应用软件 Application software：文书处理、数据库管理系统 DBMS、浏览器等，让用户完成特定工作。

记住：防毒/反恶意软件属 utility（系统软件）；Google Chrome 属应用软件。

ex.q: Classify: (1) Android (2) anti-malware (3) Google Chrome.
ex.a:
(1) System software – operating system
(2) System software – utility program
(3) Application software
ex.az: (1)(2) 是系统软件，(3) 是应用软件。

cards.en:
Process is the series of steps in an information system that ensures the data and related analysis achieve the purpose precisely. It determines the order in which data is processed. To convert data into useful information, data should be processed in a meaningful way.

Book example (hospital):
  1. Doctor examines the patient, writes a medical report and a prescription.
  2. Nurse updates the patient's medical record according to the report.
  3. Pharmacist dispenses medicine and updates related data such as the stock quantity.
  4. The system generates a receipt (payment).
  5. The system produces an operating statement at the end of the month.
The order matters: the pharmacist cannot dispense before the prescription exists, and the monthly statement needs all earlier records.
cards.zh:
Process（流程）是资讯系统中的一连串步骤，确保数据及分析能准确达到目的，决定数据处理的先后次序。

课本医院例子：1. 医生诊症，写报告和处方；2. 护士按报告更新病历；3. 药剂师配药并更新存货数量；4. 系统发出收据；5. 月底系统产生营运报表。

次序很重要：没有处方不能配药；月结报表要用到之前所有记录。

ex.q: Put in order for a library: (a) system prints monthly overdue report (b) reader brings book to counter (c) staff scans book and reader card (d) system updates book status to 'on loan'.
ex.az: 先到柜台，扫描，更新状态，最后月报。

cards.en:
Personnel are the people involved in an information system:
  • Computer engineer: design, build and integrate the hardware, software and network.
  • Systems analyst: design a system to fulfil the business needs and requirements provided by end users; analyse the time, cost and feasibility of building the system.
  • Programmer: develop the system according to the design given by systems analysts.
  • Technical support: assist the end users in using the information system.
  • Network manager: monitor the network communication between computer systems.
  • Database administrator (DBA): design and manage the databases.
End users are those who use the system (e.g. nurses, librarians).
cards.zh:
人员 Personnel：
• 电脑工程师：设计、建造并整合硬件、软件和网络。
• 系统分析员 systems analyst：按用户需求设计系统，分析时间、成本和可行性。
• 程序员 programmer：按系统分析员的设计编写系统。
• 技术支援：协助终端用户使用系统。
• 网络管理员：监察电脑系统之间的网络通讯。
• 数据库管理员 DBA：设计和管理数据库。

ex.q: Who should (i) check whether a new app can be built within budget, (ii) fix a user's login problem, (iii) design the tables of the school database?
ex.a:
(i) Systems analyst (feasibility, cost)
(ii) Technical support
(iii) Database administrator
ex.az: 系统分析员、技术支援、数据库管理员。

cards.en:
Data is a collection of unorganised facts which usually has no meaning on its own. Without processing it is difficult to draw an accurate and meaningful conclusion from it.
Information: after processing, data is put into context and converted into information. It becomes relevant to the needs of the users and serves a purpose in decision making.

Activity 1.1 shows a jumble: “81, Boatman, 62, Olympia, Sydney, Miller…”. Activity 1.2 puts the same values into a table with headings (First name, Last name, Age, City, Occupation, Score…), so each value now has a meaning.

Note: the same item can be information for one task and data for the next (e.g. a class average is information to a teacher but data for the school's yearly trend analysis).
cards.zh:
Data（数据）是一堆未经整理、本身通常没有意义的事实。未经处理很难得出准确有意义的结论。
Information（资讯）：数据经处理后被放进语境 (put into context)，变成资讯，与用户需要相关，并可用于决策。

活动 1.1：一堆散乱的字和数字；活动 1.2：同样的值放进有标题的表格，每个值就有了意义。

注意：同一样东西对某工作是资讯，对下一个工作可以是数据。

ex.q: Activity 1.3 style: for each pair, which is data and which is information? (a) hourly temperatures of room 101 / average temperature of room 101 (b) raw footage of a speech / transcript of the speech (c) a real-life photo of cats / number of cats in the photo
ex.a:
(a) Data: hourly temperatures; Information: average.
(b) Data: raw footage; Information: transcript.
(c) Data: the photo; Information: number of cats (obtained by processing the photo).
ex.az: 处理前的是数据，处理后得出的是资讯。注意 (c) 照片是数据、猫的数目是资讯。

cards.en:
To convert data into information there are three steps:
  1. Data is input into the computer.
  2. The computer processes the input data.
  3. Meaningful information is output from the computer.
This procedure is called the input-process-output cycle (IPO cycle).

Book example (Fig 1.5): a list of weights of primary students (input) is processed (grouped and counted) and output as a histogram “Weight of Primary Students”, from which we can see the most common weight range.

When answering, name each stage concretely: Input = what data and which device; Process = what calculation/sorting; Output = what result and in what form.
cards.zh:
把数据变成资讯有三步：1. 输入数据；2. 电脑处理；3. 输出有意义的资讯。这叫 input-process-output cycle (IPO cycle)。

课本例子：输入一堆小学生体重，处理（分组计数），输出成直方图，一眼看出最常见的体重范围。

答题时每一步要具体写：输入什么数据/用什么装置；做什么运算；输出什么结果、什么形式。

ex.q: Describe the IPO cycle for a program that finds the class average of test marks.
ex.a:
Input: marks of all students typed with a keyboard.
Process: add all marks and divide by the number of students.
marks = [72, 65, 88]
avg = sum(marks) / len(marks)
Output: the average (75.0) displayed on the monitor.
ex.az: 输入分数，处理为求和再除以人数，输出平均分到屏幕。

cards.en:
Multimedia data types are text, image, audio and video.
Text includes various types of characters such as numbers, letters, symbols. When stored in a computer, text is represented by a character encoding system; text in different languages may use different encoding systems.
EncodingLanguageExamples
ASCIIEnglish1234 ABCD
Big5Traditional Chinese一二三四 甲乙丙丁
(Encoding is studied fully in Chapter 3.)
cards.zh:
多媒体 multimedia 数据类型：文本、图像、音频、影片。
Text（文本）包括数字、字母、符号等字符。储存在电脑时用字符编码系统 character encoding system表示，不同语言可用不同编码：ASCII（英文）、Big5（繁体中文）。详见第 3 章。

ex.q: In Python, show that the letter 'A' is stored as a number in ASCII.
ex.a:
print(ord('A'))   # 65
print(chr(66))    # B
Each character maps to a code number, which the computer stores in binary.
ex.az: ord() 取得字符编码，'A' 是 65。

cards.en:
There are two types of text:
  • Plain text stores characters only (e.g. a .txt file in Notepad). Small file size, simple.
  • Formatted text stores characters and their formatting data, such as font type, font size, font colour, line spacing, text alignment (e.g. a .docx in Word). Its file size is relatively larger than that of plain text.
MC traps: “plain text stores font size” is wrong; “formatted text usually does not support font colour” is wrong; the correct statement is formatted text usually has a larger file size than plain text.
cards.zh:
两类文本：
• 纯文本 plain text 只储存字符（如记事本 .txt），档案细。
• 格式化文本 formatted text 储存字符及格式资料：字体、字号、颜色、行距、对齐（如 Word .docx），档案比纯文本大。

MC 陷阱：说纯文本储存字号是错的；正确的是格式化文本档案通常较大。

ex.q: A student saves the same 26-word poem as poem.txt and poem.docx. Which is larger and why?
ex.a: poem.docx is larger because formatted text stores formatting data (font type, size, colour, alignment) in addition to the characters; poem.txt stores characters only.
ex.az: docx 较大，因为额外储存格式资料。

cards.en:
Digital images are images captured by digital cameras or made with image editing software.
  • Bitmap images are stored as a series of little squares called pixels. Each pixel is assigned a binary number which indicates its colour (e.g. an 11 × 11 pixel image). Scaling up makes it blurry / jagged.
  • Vector images are stored as mathematical formulae, which connect points to draw lines, curves, circles, polygons.
TypeAdvantage
BitmapReal-life digital photos are usually bitmap; can be edited by common software like Microsoft Paint.
VectorFile size tends to be smaller; no rough edges and will not become blurry when scaled up or down.
Digital (camera) images are usually bitmap images.
cards.zh:
数码图像由数码相机拍摄或用图像编辑软件制作。
• 位图 bitmap：由一格格像素 pixel组成，每个像素有一个代表颜色的二进制数。放大会变模糊/锯齿。优点：真实照片通常是位图；可用小画家等普通软件编辑。
• 矢量图 vector：以数学公式储存，连接点画线、曲线、圆、多边形。优点：档案通常较小；放大缩小都不会模糊、没有锯齿。

适合标志 logo 用矢量；照片用位图。

ex.q: An 11 × 11 pixel image uses 1 byte per pixel. How many bytes of pixel data? A company wants a logo printed on both a pen and a bus. Which type?
ex.a:
11 × 11 = 121 pixels → 121 bytes.
Use a vector image: it can be scaled up for the bus without becoming blurry.
ex.az: 121 字节；logo 用矢量图，放大不会模糊。

cards.en:
Digital audios are data that can be converted to sounds, which are analog signals. When sounds are recorded they are stored as digital audio so that they can be edited and reproduced.
Audio processing (Fig 1.11): Sound (analog) → microphone → electricity (analog) → sound card → binary number (digital) → data storage / audio editing software → sound card → speaker → sound (analog) → ear.

So sound, the electric signal from a microphone and music played from a speaker are analog; the stored file is digital.

Enrichment: a MIDI file stores data of musical notes or digitally sampled sounds instead of a recording from a microphone, so it is easier to edit and tends to be smaller.
cards.zh:
数码音频是可转换成声音（模拟讯号）的数据。录音后以数码形式储存，方便编辑和重播。
流程：声音(模拟)→咪高峰→电讯号(模拟)→声卡→二进制(数码)→储存/编辑软件→声卡→喇叭→声音(模拟)→耳朵。

声音、咪高峰的电讯号、喇叭播出的音乐都是模拟讯号；档案是数码。
增润：MIDI 储存音符资料而非录音，易编辑、档案小。

ex.q: Which are analog signals? (1) electricity from a microphone (2) music played from a speaker (3) a MIDI file
ex.a: (1) and (2) are analog. (3) is a digital file.
ex.az: (1)(2) 是模拟讯号，MIDI 档是数码。

cards.en:
Videos are combinations of images and audios. By showing a collection of images within a short time, a moving image is created; combining a moving image with audio creates a video.
Since videos tend to have larger file sizes, they are usually stored as compressed files (compression reduces size, not to raise quality).
To make videos we use digital cameras or video editing software (not just any photo editor).
cards.zh:
影片是图像和音频的组合。短时间内连续显示多张图像形成动态影像，再加上声音就是影片。
影片档案通常很大，所以一般以压缩档储存（压缩是为了减少档案大小，不是提高质素）。
制作影片用数码相机或影片编辑软件。

ex.q: A 10-second clip shows 30 images per second. How many images? Each image is 2 MB uncompressed. What is the size, and why compress?
ex.a: 10 × 30 = 300 images; 300 × 2 MB = 600 MB (images only). It is too large to store/transmit easily, so videos are compressed to reduce file size.
ex.az: 300 张、600 MB，太大所以要压缩。

cards.en:
Information processing converts raw data into meaningful information. There are seven stages: data collection → organisation → storage → processing → analysis → transmission → presentation.
Memory aid: “C-O-S-P-A-T-P”.

In a real system the stages often repeat as a cycle: presented information can become new data for the next round.
cards.zh: 资讯处理把原始数据变成有意义的资讯。七个阶段：收集 collection → 组织 organisation → 储存 storage → 处理 processing → 分析 analysis → 传送 transmission → 展示 presentation。记法 C-O-S-P-A-T-P。实际上会循环，输出的资讯可成为下一轮的数据。

ex.q: A teacher runs an online survey on homework load. Match each action to a stage: (a) results emailed to principal (b) responses saved in the cloud (c) students fill the form (d) bar chart shown at assembly (e) blank or invalid replies removed (f) average hours per class worked out (g) trends compared between forms
ex.a: (a) Transmission (b) Storage (c) Collection (d) Presentation (e) Organisation (validation) (f) Processing (g) Analysis
ex.az: 依次：传送、储存、收集、展示、组织、处理、分析。

cards.t: Data collection: methods, scope, data type
cards.tz: 数据收集：方法、范围、数据类型
cards.en:
Data can be collected by observation, experiments, interviews, surveys, etc. Efficiency and precision can be enhanced by input devices like microphones, sensors and cameras.
To collect data efficiently, consider:
  • Scope: counting students in a classroom can be done manually; counting people in a mall is better done with sensors at the entrances.
  • Data type: noise assessment → sound level meter; speed of vehicles → speed enforcement camera.
cards.zh:
收集方法：观察、实验、访问、问卷调查等；用输入装置（咪高峰、感应器、相机）可提高效率和准确度。
要考虑：
• 范围 scope：数课室人数可人手点算；数商场人流应在入口装感应器。
• 数据类型 data type：噪音评估用声级计；车速用测速相机。

ex.q: Suggest a collection method for (i) opinions of 30 teachers about e-learning (ii) daily visitors to a theme park (iii) temperature in a greenhouse every minute.
ex.a:
(i) Survey/questionnaire or interviews.
(ii) Sensors / turnstile counters at entrances (large scope).
(iii) Temperature sensor connected to a computer (data type, frequency).
ex.az: (i) 问卷/访问 (ii) 入口感应器 (iii) 温度感应器。

cards.en:
Organisation means managing, categorising and classifying the collected data in a specific way to facilitate the processing afterwards. Common ways: data arrangement, data validation and data type conversion.
Book example (paper questionnaires from different classes):
  • Data arrangement: sorting the questionnaires from the same class into one folder.
  • Data validation: checking if a questionnaire is filled correctly.
  • Data type conversion: entering the data of a questionnaire in electronic form.
Example 1.1: putting footage filmed in the same week into one folder and stating the creation date in filenames help searching; subtitling does not make searching easier.
cards.zh:
组织 = 用特定方式管理、分类收集到的数据，方便之后处理。常见做法：数据整理 arrangement、数据核实 validation、数据类型转换 conversion。
课本例子（纸本问卷）：同班问卷放同一文件夹（整理）；检查有没有填错（核实）；把问卷资料输入电脑（类型转换）。
例题 1.1：同一周拍的片段放同一文件夹、档名注明日期，有助搜寻；加字幕不能帮助搜寻。

ex.q: Example 1.1 (adapted): Diana has over 200 footages. Which help her search more efficiently? (1) subtitling (2) creation date in filenames (3) same-week footages in one folder
ex.a: (2) lets her search by date; (3) groups related footage. (1) makes footage more accessible but not easier to search. Answer: (2) and (3) only.

cards.en:
After organisation, data is stored so that it can be retrieved and processed anytime. Data can be stored as physical copies (paper files) or in digital storage like a hard disk, USB flash drive, cloud storage, etc.
Choose storage by capacity, portability and access: e.g. to bring a spreadsheet to the teacher, a USB flash drive is portable; for long-term backup of many files, a hard disk or cloud.
cards.zh: 组织后，数据被储存，以便随时取回和处理。可储存为实体副本（纸本）或数码储存（硬盘、USB 手指、云端）。按容量、便携性选择：例如把试算表带给老师可用 USB 手指。

ex.q: Tom stores survey results in a spreadsheet. Suggest a storage device to bring the file to his teacher.
ex.a: A USB flash drive (portable); alternatively upload to cloud storage.
ex.az: USB 手指或云端。

cards.en:
Processing means editing, modifying and updating data. Types include text processing, image processing, audio processing and video processing.
Book example: raw footage of a journey is edited with video processing software before it goes into a travel show:
  • deleting unwanted scenes;
  • removing ambient noise and adding proper background music;
  • adding subtitles.
Calculations such as totals or averages are also processing.
cards.zh:
处理 = 编辑、修改和更新数据。类型：文字、图像、音频、影片处理。

cards.en:
Data analysis extracts meaningful information from the processed data through various means (charts, statistics, comparison, trends).
Book example: putting the annual average temperature of Hong Kong in the past 50 years into a spreadsheet helps identify climate trends and make better predictions.
Processing changes the data; analysis looks for patterns and conclusions in it.
cards.zh:
分析 = 透过各种方法从处理后的数据中抽取有意义的资讯（图表、统计、趋势）。
例子：把香港过去 50 年年平均气温放入试算表，找出气候趋势并作预测。
处理是改动数据；分析是找规律和结论。

ex.q: Yearly averages: 23.0, 23.1, 23.3, 23.4, 23.6 °C. What can be concluded?
ex.a: Each year is higher than the last: a warming trend of about 0.15 °C per year ((23.6−23.0)/4). This is analysis.

cards.en:
Data transmission involves transmitters, media and receivers. Transmission of data between multiple devices is important.
Network is one possible medium. It requires that both the transmitter and the receiver use the same protocol. Example: website content is transmitted from web servers to users using Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP).

cards.en:
With the rapid development of information and communication technology, microcomputers, the internet and search engines have been improved constantly. Accessing and publishing information have become easier and more popular: this is the Information Age.
Examples:
  • Academic search engines help us search for journal articles in no time;
  • Social media provide platforms to publish our opinions;
  • Smartphones and mobile networks allow us to live stream anywhere;
  • Movies and dramas can be released via streaming platforms instead of cinemas or TV.
cards.zh: 资讯及通讯科技急速发展，微电脑、互联网和搜寻器不断改进，取得和发布资讯变得更容易、更普及，这就是资讯时代 Information Age。例子：学术搜寻器快速找期刊文章；社交媒体发表意见；智能电话和流动网络随处直播；电影剧集经串流平台发行。

ex.q: Give two examples showing that publishing information has become easier in the Information Age.
ex.a:
1. Anyone can post opinions on social media instantly.
2. A creator can live stream with a smartphone over a mobile network, or release a video on a streaming platform without a TV station.
ex.az: 社交媒体发帖；用手机直播/串流平台发布。

cards.t: Causes: personal computers and mobile devices
cards.tz: 成因：个人电脑与流动装置
cards.en:
Three causes from personal computers and mobile devices:
  • Price: people can buy computer components at more affordable prices thanks to hardware development, so personal computers and mobile devices have become more widespread.
  • Performance: the computing power of mobile devices has increased, allowing data to be processed and transmitted anytime and anywhere.
  • Application design: interactive design of software allows people to access desired information directly, e.g. the rating system of an online shopping mall, and commenting and subscription on a video sharing platform.
cards.zh:

• 效能：流动装置运算能力提升，可随时随地处理和传送数据。
• 应用设计：软件的互动设计让人直接取得想要的资讯，如网购平台评分系统、影片平台的留言和订阅。

ex.q: Explain how an online shop's rating system helps people access information.
ex.a: Customers can see other buyers' ratings and reviews directly on the product page, so they get useful information about quality without searching elsewhere: an example of interactive application design.
ex.az: 评分系统让顾客直接看到其他人的评价。

cards.en:
The invention of optical fibres and the advancement of telecommunication technology have enhanced the mobility and the coverage of information.
Example: the 5G mobile network enables mobile devices to transmit data stably and efficiently between multiple devices, benefiting the development of the Internet of Things (IoT) and video streaming.
cards.zh: 光纤的发明和电讯科技进步提升了资讯的流动性和覆盖范围。例如 5G 令装置之间稳定高效地传送数据，有利于物联网 IoT 和影片串流的发展。

ex.q: State one way 5G supports the Information Age.
ex.a: 5G allows mobile devices to transmit data stably and efficiently, so people can stream video anywhere and many IoT devices can exchange data.
ex.az: 5G 稳定高速传送，支持串流和物联网。

cards.en: Internet of Things (IoT) is the network of physical objects, as small as the accelerometer in your mobile phone and as large as an observatory. Data is exchanged among devices to implement different applications, e.g. controlling electrical appliances at home from a phone (Fig 1.25). (More in Core E Ch 1.)
cards.zh: 物联网 IoT 是实体物件组成的网络，小至手机内的加速度计，大至天文台。装置之间交换数据以实现不同应用，例如用手机遥控家中电器。

ex.q: Give one IoT application at home and describe the data exchanged.
ex.a: A smart air-conditioner: a temperature sensor sends room temperature to the phone app; the app sends on/off and target temperature commands back to the air-conditioner.
ex.az: 智能冷气：感应器传温度到手机，手机传指令回冷气。

cards.t: Development: big data and artificial intelligence
cards.tz: 发展：大数据与人工智能
cards.en:
Big data: due to the high usage of digital devices and online platforms, a vast amount of data is gathered. Once processed and analysed, it can show valuable information such as the interests of customers, predictions of traffic situations and climate trends.
Artificial intelligence (AI) has the power to process and analyse a large amount of data in a short time. With deep learning, AI can even learn by itself, further improving its capability. Example: vehicle identifying technology (recognising car plates).
cards.zh:

人工智能 AI：可在短时间处理分析大量数据；借深度学习 deep learning可自我学习，不断提升能力。例子：车辆识别技术。

ex.q: A streaming platform recommends dramas to each user. Explain the roles of big data and AI.
ex.a: Big data: the platform collects viewing history of millions of users. AI: analyses this large amount of data quickly to learn each user's interests and predict which dramas they will like.
ex.az: 大数据提供观看纪录，AI 快速分析并预测喜好。

cards.en:
Information technology makes much information accessible, but we should not accept and use every piece without thinking. Four aspects of information literacy:
  • Intellectual property: the intangible creation or invention of a person. It is unethical and illegal to use or gain benefit from others' IP without permission, e.g. claiming to be the author of an article you didn't write.
  • Data privacy: respect others' privacy; don't share friends' private information on social media without their permission.
  • Credibility: not every piece of information is true. Consider authoritativeness, validity and relevance; search for more information to prove or disprove it.
  • Extraction and organisation: be original; search from various media (websites, books, TV), then extract and organise findings to form our own opinions.
cards.zh:
资讯素养四方面：
• 知识产权 IP：个人无形的创作或发明；未经许可使用或从中得益是不道德且违法的，例如冒认文章作者。
• 数据私隐：未经朋友同意不可在社交媒体分享其私人资料。
• 可信度 credibility：考虑权威性、有效性、相关性，多找资料证实或否定。
• 抽取与组织：从网站、书本、电视等多种媒介搜集，抽取整理，形成自己的观点，保持原创。

cards.en:
Data is usually stored in a hierarchical form. In a data hierarchy, every higher level is a collection of items from the lower level.
From lowest to highest: field → record → file (table) → database.
  • Field: stores a specific attribute of an entity, e.g. the name of a student. It can store data of any type (numbers, text).
  • Record: a collection of fields about one entity, e.g. the student ID, name, sex, class and class number of ONE student.
  • File (table): a collection of records sharing the same record structure, e.g. a table storing the information of 100 students.
  • Database: a collection of related files, e.g. a school database containing tables of students, teachers, classrooms and class schedules.
In a table, a field is a column and a record is a row.
cards.zh:
数据通常以层级形式 (hierarchical form) 存储：每个较高层都是较低层项目的集合。由低到高：field（字段/栏）→ record（记录/列）→ file/table（档案/数据表）→ database（数据库）。
  • Field：储存一个实体的某个属性，例如学生姓名。
  • Record：关于同一个实体的所有字段，例如一个学生的学号、姓名、性别、班别、学号。
  • File (table)：结构相同的记录的集合，例如 100 个学生的资料表。
  • Database：相关档案的集合，例如学校数据库包含学生表、老师表、课室表、时间表。
表格中：字段 = 栏 (column)，记录 = 行 (row)。注意：一个 field 不会“包含很多 records”，方向是反过来的。

ex.q: In a school database, classify: (i) the value 'Tom Ho' in ENAME, (ii) all data of Tom Ho, (iii) STUDENT table, (iv) the whole school system.
ex.a:
(i) field (one attribute)
(ii) record (all fields of one entity)
(iii) file/table (records with same structure)
(iv) database (collection of related files: STUDENT, TEACHER, CLASSROOM...)
ex.az: (i) 字段 (ii) 记录 (iii) 档案/表 (iv) 数据库。

cards.t: Database vs spreadsheet; DBMS and GUI
cards.tz: 数据库 vs 电子表格；DBMS 与 GUI
cards.en:
For managing a large amount of data, a database is usually a better choice than a spreadsheet. A database management system (DBMS) allows us to organise, store and retrieve data efficiently. A DBMS (e.g. Microsoft Access) can be used:
  • without GUI, by typing SQL statements such as SELECT * FROM STUDENT and reading text output;
  • with a graphical user interface (GUI), where tables, fields and records are shown in windows and you can click to sort, filter, insert and delete.
Data entered in an electronic form (e.g. an application form) can be stored directly as a record in a database table.
cards.zh:
管理大量数据时，数据库通常比电子表格更合适。数据库管理系统 (DBMS) 让我们有效地组织 (organise)、储存 (store) 和检索 (retrieve) 数据。使用方式有两种：
  • 不用 GUI：直接输入 SQL，如 SELECT * FROM STUDENT，以文字显示结果；
  • 用图形用户界面 (GUI)：如 Access 的窗口，可点击排序、筛选、新增、删除。
电子表单输入的资料可以直接成为数据库表中的一条记录。

ex.q: Give two reasons a school should use a DBMS instead of a spreadsheet for 2000 students' records.
ex.a:
1. A DBMS organises, stores and retrieves large amounts of data efficiently (e.g. indexing, SQL queries).
2. Related tables (students, teachers, classrooms) can be linked in one database, reducing data redundancy.
ex.az: 数据量大时 DBMS 检索更快；多个相关表可在同一数据库中关联，减少重复数据。

cards.en:
When unreliable or incoherent data is input to a data analysis, the output information will not be useful. This is called "garbage in, garbage out" (GIGO).
Therefore we should ensure input data is valid and accurate. To reduce erroneous input, data control is applied. Data control has two approaches:
  • Data validation: done by computers (automatic rule checking).
  • Data verification: done by humans (checking accuracy, e.g. entering twice, proofreading).
cards.zh:
如果输入的数据不可靠或不一致，分析出来的信息也没有用，这就是 GIGO（garbage in, garbage out）。所以要做数据控制 (data control)，确保输入数据有效和准确。两种方法：
  • Data validation（数据有效性检验）：由电脑执行。
  • Data verification（数据验证）：由人执行。

ex.q: A survey form lets students type their class freely. Answers include '4A', 'four A', '4a', 'A4'. Explain how this illustrates GIGO.
ex.a: The class field contains inconsistent/invalid values, so counting or sorting by class gives wrong results. Useless input leads to useless output. A fixed value check (drop-down list) should be applied.
ex.az: 输入格式混乱，统计结果就会错 → GIGO。可用下拉清单做 fixed value check。

cards.en:
Data can be input by manual entry, network transmission, scanners, etc. Errors that may occur:
ErrorDescriptionExampleSolution
Data source errorIncorrect data is provided by the data source.Someone gives an email address that does not exist.Send an activation code to the email and ask the user to enter it.
Transcription errorData is misread, misheard or mistyped.OCR misreads capital 'I' as small 'l' or '1'; typing 冶 as 治; price of an apple stored as price of a watermelon.Validate (e.g. spell check); verify by typing again.
Transposition errorIncorrect placement of data.Reversing two adjacent digits: $15 becomes $51.Proofread the data.
cards.zh:
输入方式：人手、网络传输、扫描器等。常见错误：
  • Data source error（数据源错误）：来源本身提供错误数据，例如不存在的电邮。解决：寄 activation code 要求输入。
  • Transcription error（抄录错误）：看错、听错、打错，例如 OCR 把 I 认成 l，冶 打成 治。解决：validation（拼写检查）、要求再输入一次。
  • Transposition error（换位错误）：位置放错，例如 $15 变 $51。解决：proofread。

ex.q: Classify: (a) a clerk types 2580 as 2850; (b) a customer gives a fake phone number; (c) OCR reads 'O' as '0'.
ex.a:
(a) transposition error (adjacent digits swapped)
(b) data source error
(c) transcription error (misread)
ex.az: (a) 换位 (b) 数据源 (c) 抄录。

cards.tz: 数据有效性检验：目的与限制
cards.en:
Data validation is part of data control. It cannot guarantee the input data is absolutely accurate. Instead, it ensures that the input data is reasonable and matches certain rules.
It is usually run automatically by systems or programs, widely used in online forms (government appointment booking, online shopping). Multiple validation methods can be applied to a single field.
Key point: a valid value may still be wrong (e.g. age 15 typed instead of 16 passes a range check).
cards.zh: 数据有效性检验是数据控制的一部分，不能保证数据绝对正确，只能确保数据合理并符合某些规则。通常由系统/程序自动执行，常见于网上表格。同一字段可用多种检验。重点：通过检验的数据仍可能是错的（例如年龄 16 打成 15 仍会通过 range check）。

ex.q: A student's age is entered as 51 instead of 15, and the form only requires age 12–99. Is the error detected?
ex.a: No. 51 is within the range 12–99, so the range check passes. Validation only checks that data is reasonable, not that it is accurate. Verification (e.g. inputting twice) could detect it.
ex.az: 不会，51 在范围内。validation 只查合理性，要用 verification 才能发现。

cards.t: Presence check and fixed value check
cards.tz: 存在检查与固定值检查
cards.en:
Presence check: ensures that there must be data in the required fields. Example: an applicant must provide their name.
Fixed value check: ensures that the data can only be selected from a list of specific values. Example: sex must be either 'M' or 'F'.
UI designs that apply fixed value check automatically: drop-down list and radio buttons (only one value) and checkboxes (several values can be selected).
cards.zh:
Presence check（存在检查）：必填字段一定要有数据，例如必须填姓名。
Fixed value check（固定值检查）：数据只能是指定清单中的值，例如性别只能 M 或 F。
可自动做到 fixed value check 的界面：下拉清单 (drop-down list)、单选按钮 (radio button)（只能选一个）、勾选框 (checkboxes)（可选多个）。

ex.q: Write a Python check for sex being 'M' or 'F' and name not empty.
ex.a:
def ok(name, sex):
    return name.strip() != '' and sex in ('M', 'F')
ok('Tom Ho','M') → True; ok('','F') → False
ex.az: name 非空 = presence check；sex in 清单 = fixed value check。

cards.en:
Type check: ensures that the data must be of a certain type, e.g. age must be a number.
Data of the same field should share the same data type to facilitate data organisation (correct sorting) and data analysis (e.g. averaging "八十五" + "Seventy two" + 91 gives an ERROR, while 85.0+72.0+91.0+79.5 gives 81.875).
Data typeDescriptionExample
Integerwhole number, positive or negative74, -29; number of students
Floating point / realcan have decimal places74.44, -2.09; score, height
String / textletters, numerals, Chinese characters, symbolsname, address
Booleanonly TRUE or FALSEpass or not
cards.zh:
Type check（类型检查）：数据必须是某种类型，例如年龄必须是数字。同一字段应使用相同类型，方便排序整理和分析（文字 "八十五" 无法计算平均）。
常见类型：Integer（整数）、Floating point/real（实数，可有小数）、String/text（字符串，含中英文、数字、符号）、Boolean（只有 TRUE/FALSE）。

ex.q: Choose data types: number of siblings, body weight, HKID number, whether a member has paid.
ex.a: Integer; floating point (real); string (letters and parentheses); Boolean.
ex.az: 整数；实数；字符串；布尔。

cards.en:
Range check: ensures that the data must be within a certain range, e.g. age must be larger than 12; a mark must be between 0 and 100.
Length check: ensures that the length of the data matches certain criteria, e.g. a phone number must have 8 digits; a password must be at least 8 characters.
Note: range check is about the value, length check is about the number of characters.
cards.zh:
Range check（范围检查）：数值在某范围内，例如年龄 > 12、分数 0–100。
Length check（长度检查）：数据长度符合要求，例如电话 8 位、密码至少 8 个字符。
区别：range 看数值大小，length 看字符个数。

ex.q: Phone '2590872' is rejected. Which check, and why?
ex.a: Length check: a HK phone number must be 8 digits but '2590872' has only 7.
ex.az: 长度检查，只有 7 位。

cards.tz: 格式、一致性、唯一性检查
cards.en:
Format check: ensures that the data is in a specific format, e.g. email must contain '@'; date as DD/MM/YYYY.
Consistency check: ensures data is reasonable when compared to the data in other fields, e.g. end date must come after the start date.
Uniqueness check: the data must be unique for the field, e.g. each student can apply once only, so no duplicated student IDs.
Remember: an email missing '@' fails a format check, not a type check.
cards.zh:
Format check（格式检查）：数据符合特定格式，如电邮要有 '@'、日期 DD/MM/YYYY。
Consistency check（一致性检查）：与其他字段比较要合理，如结束日期要在开始日期之后。
Uniqueness check（唯一性检查）：该字段的值不能重复，如学号不能重复申请。
注意：电邮缺 '@' 是 format check 失败，不是 type check。

ex.q: Start date 31/08/2025, end date 01/08/2025 is rejected. Which check?
ex.a: Consistency check: the end date (another field) must come after the start date.
ex.az: 一致性检查。

cards.en:
Instead of text boxes, interface designs make validation easier:
  • Drop-down list: fixed value check, only one of the specific values can be input.
  • Radio button: fixed value check, only one value.
  • Checkboxes: fixed value check, multiple values can be selected.
  • Date picker: type check (only dates; invalid dates like 32/08/2025 cannot be picked) and format check (e.g. DD/MM/YYYY).
  • Slider: value limited to a range (built-in range/type check).
Advantage: they reduce input errors.
cards.zh:
用其他元件代替文字框，令检验更容易：
  • 下拉清单、单选按钮：fixed value check，只能一个值。
  • 勾选框：fixed value check，可多选。
  • 日期选择器 (date picker)：type check（不能选 32/08/2025）+ format check。
  • 滑杆 (slider)：值限于范围。
好处：减少输入错误。

ex.q: A rating slider (1–5) is replaced by a text box. Which validations are needed now?
ex.a: Type check (must be a number) and range check (1 to 5). Uniqueness is not needed because many customers can give the same rating.
ex.az: 需要 type check 与 range check，不需唯一性。

cards.en:
A check digit is a data validation method commonly used for numeric data such as identity numbers, book numbers (ISBN) and credit card numbers.
It is generated by a specific algorithm and appended to the end of the numeric data. It can consist of more than one digit.
If the check digit does not match the algorithm, the data is proved to be invalid. Check digits are good at detecting transcription and transposition errors when typing numbers.
cards.zh: 查数位 (check digit) 常用于数字资料（身份证、ISBN、信用卡号）。它由特定算法产生并附加在数据末端，可多于一位。若查数位与算法不符，数据必定无效。适合发现抄录和换位错误。

ex.q: A school uses an 8-digit ID whose digits must sum to a multiple of 12. Is 4314 0624 valid?
ex.az: 数字和 24 可被 12 整除，有效。

cards.tz: 香港身份证查数位算法
cards.en:
HKID: one or two letters + six digits + check digit in parentheses (0–9 or A).
  1. Ignore parentheses. If only one letter, add a whitespace at the beginning (making 9 characters).
  2. Convert letters: A=10, B=11, …, Z=35, whitespace=36.
  3. Weights 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 from the 1st to the 9th character; multiply and add to get the weighted sum.
  4. Valid if weighted sum mod 11 = 0.
To find a check digit: remainder r of (sum of first 8 weighted characters) ÷ 11; check digit = 11 − r (10 → 'A'; if r = 0, check digit 0).
cards.zh:
香港身份证：1–2 个字母 + 6 位数字 + 括号内查数位（0–9 或 A）。
  1. 去括号；只有一个字母时在前面加空格。
  2. 字母转数字：A=10…Z=35，空格=36。
  3. 权重由第 1 至第 9 位为 9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2,1，相乘后加总。
  4. 加权和可被 11 整除即有效。
求查数位：前 8 位加权和除以 11 得余数 r，查数位 = 11 − r（10 写 A，r=0 则为 0）。

ex.q: Find the check digit of Y147036.
Is WX135135(2) valid?
ex.az: 627 可被 11 整除，有效。

cards.en:
Data is stored as binary codes. To detect errors during data transmission, a parity bit is appended to the end of the binary code so that the total number of 1s is even (even parity) or odd (odd parity). This is a parity check.
OriginalEven parityOdd parity
00000000000000000000001
10101011010101010101011
11100111110011111100110
Limitation: if two bits (an even number of bits) are flipped, the count stays even/odd, so the error is not detected. Passing a parity check does not mean no error.
cards.zh: 资料以二进制储存。传输时在末端加一个奇偶检验位 (parity bit)，令 1 的总数为偶数（even parity）或奇数（odd parity）。限制：若有两个位（偶数个位）同时出错，1 的个数奇偶不变，检测不到。所以通过 parity check 不代表没有错误。

ex.q: Add an odd parity bit to 0100101.
ex.a: Number of 1s = 3 (odd) → parity bit 0 → 01001010.
ex.az: 有 3 个 1 已是奇数，加 0。

ex.q: Codes 11011000, 11101011, 00100101, 01001000 received; only one passes. Which parity and which code?
ex.a: Count 1s: 4, 6, 3, 2. Three are even, one odd. Since only one passes, it must be odd parity; 00100101 passes.
ex.az: 只有一个通过，所以是奇校验，00100101。

cards.en:
Data verification helps determine whether the data is accurate and consistent when being transferred between media (done by humans).
  • Inputting data twice: an operator inputs the same data twice; the two copies are compared. E.g. enter a new password twice.
  • Double data entry: two operators input the same data independently; copies are compared. E.g. two operators enter paper questionnaires.
  • Proofreading data: another operator compares the input data against the original document. E.g. print the mark sheet and check against exam papers.
cards.zh:
数据验证 (verification)：确认数据在不同媒体间转移时准确一致，由人执行。
  • Inputting data twice（输入两次）：同一人输入两次再比较，如新密码输入两次。
  • Double data entry（双重输入）：两个操作员独立输入，再比较。
  • Proofreading（校对）：另一人把输入数据与原文件对照。

ex.q: A clerk types 0010 0000 as 0100 000. Which can detect it: double data entry, parity check, length check?
ex.a: Double data entry: yes (the two copies differ). Length check: yes (7 bits, not 8). Parity check: no (both contain one '1').
ex.az: 双重输入和长度检查可以，奇偶检验不行（1 的个数都是 1）。

cards.en:
Data validationData verification
Done bycomputers, automaticallyhumans
Purposedata is reasonable and follows rulesdata is accurate/consistent with the source
Examplespresence, fixed value, type, range, length, format, consistency, uniqueness, check digit, parityinputting twice, double data entry, proofreading
Neither alone guarantees correct data; they are used together.
cards.zh: Validation：电脑自动，检查数据合理；verification：人手，检查数据与来源一致准确。Parity check 与 check digit 属 validation；输入两次、双重输入、校对属 verification。

ex.q: Classify 'click the link sent to your email to confirm the address'.
ex.a: It confirms the data source (email exists and belongs to the user); in the book this solves a data source error. It is not one of the three listed verification methods.
ex.az: 用于处理数据源错误。

cards.en:
Data in a database is organised according to the database structure. A good structure enables better communication between different tables and reduces data redundancy. Choosing data types of fields wisely benefits data consistency and data analysis.
Example table structure: SID String (a number cannot have leading zeros, so ID like 015034 is stored as text), NAME String, SEX String, CLASS String, CNO Integer.
cards.zh: 数据库内的资料按数据库结构组织。好的结构令不同表之间更好沟通并减少数据冗余。选择合适的数据类型有助一致性与分析。例子：SID 用 String，因为数字不能有前导零（015034），CNO 用 Integer。

ex.q: Why should a 16-digit serial number '0000123456789000' be stored as text?
ex.a: Numbers lose leading zeros (it would become 123456789000), and no arithmetic is done on it, so it must be stored as text with length = 16.
ex.az: 数字会去掉前导零，所以用文字并检查长度 16。

cards.en:
We can insert new records and change or delete existing records using Structured Query Language (SQL) or through a GUI. To save time entering data manually, we can import files in other formats like .csv (comma-separated values) to create many records at once.
INSERT INTO STUDENT (SID, ENAME, SEX, CLASS, CNO)
VALUES ('015044', 'Peter Chan', 'M', '1A', 11);
cards.zh: 可以用 SQL 或 GUI 新增、修改、删除记录；也可汇入 .csv（逗号分隔值）档案一次建立大量记录。

ex.q: Write SQL to add student 015050 Tom Ho, M, 1A, 12.
ex.a:
INSERT INTO STUDENT (SID, ENAME, SEX, CLASS, CNO)
VALUES ('015050', 'Tom Ho', 'M', '1A', 12);
ex.az: SID 用引号，因为是文字。

cards.tz: 数据库功能：检索与排序
cards.en:
Specific data can be retrieved using SQL or GUI, and sorted by certain criteria.
SELECT * FROM STUDENT WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT * FROM STUDENT WHERE SEX = 'M' ORDER BY ENAME;
The first returns records of male students; the second sorts them by name in ascending order.
cards.zh: 可用 SQL 或 GUI 检索 (retrieve) 特定数据，并按条件排序。WHERE 筛选，ORDER BY 排序（默认升序）。

ex.q: List names of class 1A students sorted by class number descending.
ex.a: SELECT ENAME FROM STUDENT WHERE CLASS = '1A' ORDER BY CNO DESC;
ex.az: DESC 表示降序。

cards.t: Index: how it speeds up retrieval
cards.en:
Without an index, the DBMS searches a field row by row; worst case it checks the whole table (11 records to find 'Peter Chan').
Indexing a frequently searched field creates an index table containing the indexed field and a pointer to the related record. The index is sorted (e.g. alphabetically), so each check filters out about half of the remaining records (binary search). For 11 names, at most 4 checks are needed.
Steps for 'Peter Chan': check 6th 'Liliana' (L < P, discard first half) → 9th 'Roberta' (R > P) → 7th 'Nolan' → 8th 'Peter Chan' found.
cards.zh: 没有索引时 DBMS 要逐行搜寻，最坏要看整个表。索引 (index) 建立一个只含被索引字段和指向记录的指针 (pointer) 的索引表，且已排序，每次检查可排除约一半记录（二分搜寻），11 个记录最多检查 4 次。

ex.q: Worst-case checks to find a name among 1000 records, without and with an index?
ex.a: Without index: 1000 (linear). With a sorted index: about log₂1000 → 10 checks.
ex.az: 无索引 1000 次；有索引约 10 次。

cards.en:
Indexing is not free. The index table must be updated when:
  • the value of the indexed field changes (e.g. 'Peter Chan' → 'Pierre Chan');
  • a new record is added (e.g. 'Alison Waller').
Updating takes time, and the index table needs extra storage space. So index a field only if necessary; indexing too many fields is not recommended.
Misconception: indexing does not reduce the storage size of a database; it increases it.
cards.zh: 索引有代价：当被索引字段改变或新增记录时，索引表要更新，需要时间和额外储存空间。所以只在需要时建立索引，不宜索引太多字段。常见误解：索引不会减少数据库容量，反而增加。

ex.q: A log table receives thousands of inserts per second and is rarely searched. Should several fields be indexed?
ex.a: No. Every insert would require updating each index, slowing down insertion and using extra storage, while the benefit (faster search) is rarely used.
ex.az: 插入多、搜寻少，不宜建立多个索引。

cards.en:
Storage devices determine how data is accessed. With sequential access, data is written sequentially from the beginning, and to access specific data the system must search through the storage sequentially (to access the 5th element, process all elements before it).
Device using sequential access only: magnetic tape.
Access speed varies depending on where the target data is located; on average it is slower than direct access. Suitable when the whole file is processed in order (e.g. backup, reading the entire database).
cards.zh: 顺序存取：数据从头依次写入，读取时要顺序搜寻（读第 5 个要先经过前 4 个）。只支持顺序存取的装置：磁带 (magnetic tape)。速度视数据位置而定，平均比直接存取慢；适合整个档案依次处理，例如备份或读入整个数据库。

ex.q: A new POS terminal must read the whole product database into memory. Which access mode?
ex.a: Sequential access: every record must be read anyway, so reading in order from the start is efficient; no need to jump to specific positions.
ex.az: 要读全部记录，用顺序存取即可。

cards.en:
With direct access, data can be written in any storage position. Each storage position has a unique address, so data can be accessed directly without searching through other positions.
Devices: hard disk, USB flash drive, optical discs, floppy disk.
Thanks to unique addresses, its access speed is more stable and generally faster than sequential access. Suitable for looking up one record quickly (e.g. a product's price at a POS).
cards.zh: 直接存取：数据可写在任何位置，每个位置有唯一地址，可直接读取，无需经过其他位置。装置：硬盘、USB 手指、光碟、软碟。速度较稳定且一般较快，适合快速查找单一记录（如收银机查价）。

ex.q: Searching one product's price at a supermarket: which access mode and why?
ex.a: Direct access: the record can be located directly by its address/index without reading other records, so lookup is fast.
ex.az: 直接存取，直接定位，速度快。

cards.en:
AttributeMagnetic tapeHard disk
File access methodSequentialDirect
Data access rateUnpredictable, averagely lowerStable, averagely higher
Unit price per capacityLowerHigher
PortabilityHigherLower
LifespanLongerShorter
Common usageBackup storageFrequently used data
Misconception: optical discs are not sequential-only; they support direct access.
cards.zh: 磁带：顺序存取、速度不稳定较慢、每单位容量较便宜、较便携、寿命较长，常用于备份。硬盘：直接存取、速度稳定较快、较贵、便携性较低、寿命较短，用于常用数据。误解：光碟不是只支持顺序存取。

ex.q: Why do companies still back up to magnetic tape?
ex.a: Lower price per capacity and longer lifespan; backups are written and read as a whole, so sequential access is not a big disadvantage.
ex.az: 便宜、寿命长；备份整体读写，顺序存取影响不大。

cards.en:
A bit (b) is the most basic unit of data; it is either 0 or 1. Digital devices use the binary system because they store data in bits. Larger units are binary-based (powers of 2):
UnitValue
1 Byte (B)8 bits
1 KB210 B = 1024 B
1 MB1024 KB = 220 B
1 GB1024 MB = 230 B
1 TB1024 GB = 240 B
Some manufacturers use decimal-based units (1 KB = 1000 B), which is why a '1 TB' hard disk shows less than 1 TB in Windows. In DSE, treat units of data as binary-based: 1 KB = 1024 B (a common misconception is 1 KB = 1000 B).
cards.zh:
bit 是最基本的数据单位，只能是 0 或 1。数码装置用二进制，因为数据以 bit 储存。较大的单位以 2 的幂计：1 B = 8 bits，1 KB = 1024 B，1 MB = 1024 KB，1 GB = 1024 MB，1 TB = 1024 GB。
有些硬盘厂商用十进制（1 KB = 1000 B），所以标称 1 TB 的硬盘在 Windows 只显示约 931 GB。考试时一律用 1024 换算，常见误解就是写成 1 KB = 1000 B。

cards.en: Bitrate (data transfer rate) is the amount of data transferred per unit time. Unlike units of data, bitrate units are decimal-based: 1 kbps = 1000 bps, 1 Mbps = 1000 kbps = 106 bps, 1 Gbps = 1000 Mbps = 109 bps, 1 Tbps = 1012 bps. A lowercase b means bit; uppercase B means byte (kBps, MBps are rarely used). Key contrast to memorise: 1 MB = 1024 KB but 1 Mbps = 1000 kbps. When computing download time, convert file size to bits (×8) and use the decimal bitrate.
cards.zh: 比特率 / 数据传输率是每单位时间传送的数据量，单位是十进制：1 kbps = 1000 bps，1 Mbps = 1000 kbps，1 Gbps = 1000 Mbps。小写 b = bit，大写 B = byte。要背：1 MB = 1024 KB，但 1 Mbps = 1000 kbps。计下载时间时先把档案大小 ×8 变成 bit，再除以比特率。

ex.q: How long does it take to download a 25 MB file at 100 Mbps (ignore overhead)?

cards.en: A decimal (denary) number is in base 10, using digits 0–9. A binary number is in base 2, using only 0 and 1; each binary digit represents one bit. Each digit has a place value that is a power of the base: in binary, from right to left 20=1, 21=2, 22=4, 23=8 ... To avoid confusion we write the base as a subscript, e.g. 110110 versus 11012. 3-bit binary numbers 000 to 111 represent 0 to 7.
cards.zh: 十进制以 10 为底（0–9），二进制以 2 为底（只有 0 和 1），每个二进制位代表 1 bit。每一位有位值 (place value)，二进制由右至左是 1、2、4、8、16……为免混淆，要写下标，如 110110 和 11012 不同。3 位二进制 000–111 代表 0–7。

ex.q: Write 0 to 7 as 3-bit binary numbers.
ex.az: 依次加 1，满 2 进位。

cards.en: To convert a binary number to decimal, expand by place values: multiply each digit by its place value (power of 2) and add the results. Only the positions holding 1 contribute. Example table for 11012: place values 8, 4, 2, 1 → 8×1 + 4×1 + 2×0 + 1×1 = 13. A quick check: an n-digit binary number starting with 1 is between 2n-1 and 2n−1.
cards.zh: 二进制转十进制：按位值展开，每位乘以 2 的幂再相加，只有 1 的位置有贡献。例如 11012 = 8+4+0+1 = 13。检查方法：n 位、首位是 1 的二进制数介乎 2n-1 至 2n−1。

ex.q: Convert 10110101<sub>2</sub> to decimal.

cards.en: Repeated division by 2: divide the decimal number by 2 repeatedly, recording each remainder, until the quotient is smaller than 2. Then read the last quotient followed by the remainders from the last one to the first one (bottom-up). Alternative: subtract the largest powers of 2 that fit. To store in N bits, add leading 0s.
cards.zh: 连除以 2 取余数：不断除以 2 记下余数，直至商小于 2，然后由最后的商及余数由下而上排列。也可以用减去最大的 2 的幂的方法。要 N 位表示时在前面补 0。

ex.q: Convert 118<sub>10</sub> to binary.
ex.az: 连除取余，由下往上读：1110110。

ex.q: Convert 149<sub>10</sub> to binary.

cards.en: Binary arithmetic works like decimal arithmetic, but you carry when a column reaches 2 and borrow 2 from the next column. Rules: 0+0=0, 0+1=1, 1+1=10 (write 0 carry 1), 1+1+1=11 (write 1 carry 1). For subtraction: 0−1 needs a borrow, giving 10−1=1. Check answers by converting to decimal.
cards.zh: 二进制加减和十进制一样，只是满 2 进 1、借 1 当 2。1+1=10（写 0 进 1），1+1+1=11。减法 0−1 要向左借位，得 10−1=1。做完可转十进制核对。

ex.q: Calculate 101101<sub>2</sub> + 111110<sub>2</sub>.
Calculate 1100101<sub>2</sub> − 111011<sub>2</sub>.

cards.t: Number of patterns and bits needed
cards.en: The number of unique patterns (combinations) determines how much data can be represented. With b bits: number of patterns = 2b. To represent P items you need bits = ⌈log2P⌉ (round up). On a calculator, log2P = log10P ÷ log102. Without a calculator, convert P−1 (the largest code if numbering from 0) to binary and count digits, or find the smallest power of 2 ≥ P. For a general lock/code with k symbols per position and n positions: combinations = kn. Only the field that must be unique matters (e.g. gender bits do not increase the number of unique IDs).
cards.zh: 可表示的数据量由模式数决定：b 位有 2b 个模式；要表示 P 个项目需 ⌈log2P⌉ 位（向上取整），计算机 log2P = logP ÷ log2。若每位有 k 个符号、共 n 位，组合数 = kn。注意只有要独一无二的栏位才影响数量（例如性别位不会增加学生编号数目）。

ex.q: 70,000 contestants each need a unique code. How many bytes per code?
ex.a:
log270000 ≈ 16.1 → 17 bits needed (216=65,536 < 70,000).
17 bits → round up to whole bytes: 3 bytes.
ex.az: 2^16=65536 不够，要 17 bits，即 3 bytes。

ex.q: A 3-digit lock: each digit can be 1–9 or A–F. How many combinations?
ex.a: 15 symbols per digit (0 excluded): 153 = 3375.

ex.q: A system uses 8 bits for a student ID and 1 bit for gender. Max number of students?
ex.a: Unique IDs = 28 = 256. Gender is irrelevant to uniqueness.

cards.en: A hexadecimal number is in base 16; digits are 0–9 and A–F for 10–15. Since 24=16, each hex digit represents exactly 4 bits, so hex is a compact way for programmers to write binary (e.g. colour codes #FF8800, memory addresses). Binary↔hex: group binary digits in 4s from the right and convert each group (1011 01012 = B516). Table: 1010=A, 1011=B, 1100=C, 1101=D, 1110=E, 1111=F.
cards.zh: 十六进制以 16 为底，用 0–9 及 A–F 代表 10–15。因为 2⁴=16，每个十六进制位刚好代表 4 bits，所以程序员常用它简写二进制（例如颜色码、内存地址）。二进制转十六进制：由右起每 4 位一组逐组转换，如 1011 0101 = B5。

ex.q: Convert 1110 0101<sub>2</sub> to hexadecimal.
How many bits does a 3-digit hex code (000–FFF) use?
ex.az: 每位 4 bits，共 12 bits。

cards.tz: 十六进制与十进制互换
cards.en:
Hex → decimal: expand by place values 163=4096, 162=256, 161=16, 160=1. B4AF16 = 11×4096 + 4×256 + 10×16 + 15 = 45056+1024+160+15 = 46255.
Decimal → hex: repeatedly divide by 16, record remainders (write 10–15 as A–F), read from last to first. Hex addition: add column by column; carry 1 when a column sum ≥ 16 (subtract 16).
cards.zh: 十六进制转十进制：按位值 4096、256、16、1 展开。十进制转十六进制：连除以 16 取余数（10–15 写成 A–F），由下而上读。十六进制加法：每列和 ≥16 就减 16 进 1。

ex.q: Convert 9C7E<sub>16</sub> to decimal.
ex.az: 逐位乘位值相加得 40062。

ex.q: Convert 54625<sub>10</sub> to hexadecimal.
ex.az: 连除 16，余数由下往上：D561。

ex.q: Calculate B4AF<sub>16</sub> + 9C7E<sub>16</sub>.
ex.az: 逐列相加，满 16 进位，得 1512D。

cards.en: Unsigned integers are integers without a negative sign, i.e. positive integers and zero. An unsigned integer in N bits ranges from 0 to 2N − 1. E.g. 3 bits: 0 (000) to 7 (111); 8 bits: 0 to 255. To get the N-bit representation, convert to binary and pad with leading 0s: 27 in 6 bits = 011011.
cards.zh: 无符号整数没有负号，即正整数和零。N 位范围是 0 至 2N−1，例如 8 位 0–255。表示方法：转成二进制再在前面补 0，如 27 用 6 位表示为 011011。

ex.q: Represent 27<sub>10</sub> as a 6-bit unsigned integer and state the 6-bit range.

cards.en: Signed integers may be positive, negative or zero. About half of the bit patterns are used for negative numbers, so a signed integer in N bits usually ranges from −2N−1 to 2N−1 − 1. 3 bits: −4 to 3; 4 bits: −8 to 7; 8 bits: −128 to 127. Note the range is not symmetric: there is one more negative value because 0 uses a 'non-negative' pattern.
cards.zh: 有符号整数可以是正、负或零，约一半模式用来表示负数。N 位范围通常是 −2N−1 至 2N−1−1：4 位 −8 至 7，8 位 −128 至 127。范围不对称，负数多一个，因为 0 占了一个非负模式。

ex.q: What is the range of a 6-bit signed integer?

cards.en: Two's complement representation is the method most computers use to represent signed integers. The first (leftmost) bit tells the sign: 0 = non-negative, 1 = negative. The first bit has a negative place value −2N−1; other bits have normal place values. So 4-bit 1010 = −8 + 2 = −6; 3-bit 101 = −4 + 1 = −3. A negative integer −X is represented by the two's complement of X. 3-bit table: 100=−4, 101=−3, 110=−2, 111=−1, 000=0, 001=1, 010=2, 011=3.
cards.zh: 二补码表示法是大部分电脑表示有符号整数的方法。最左一位是符号：0 为非负，1 为负。最左位的位值是负的 −2N−1，其余位照常。所以 4 位 1010 = −8+2 = −6。负数 −X 用 X 的二补码表示。3 位：100=−4 … 111=−1，000=0 … 011=3。

ex.q: Convert the 5-bit two's complement representation 10101 to decimal.
100011 is a 6-bit two's complement representation. What is its value?
Arrange 4-bit P=1010, Q=0101, R=1100, S=0011 in descending order.
ex.az: 先转十进制再排序。

cards.t: Two's complement vs two's complement representation
cards.tz: 二补码 与 二补码表示法 的分别
cards.en: Misconception: 'The two's complement of 3 is 011.' Wrong. 011 is the two's complement representation of +3. The two's complement of 3 is 101, which is the two's complement representation of −3. In short: the two's complement of an integer X is the two's complement representation of −X. Pay attention to the word 'representation' in MC questions. E.g. the 3-bit two's complement of 1 is 111 (= −1).
cards.zh: 误解：「3 的二补码是 011」。错。011 是 +3 的二补码表示；3 的二补码是 101，即 −3 的表示。记住：X 的二补码 = −X 的二补码表示。选择题要留意题目问的是 two's complement 还是 two's complement representation。

ex.q: What is the 8-bit two's complement of 110101<sub>2</sub>?
ex.a: Pad: 0011 0101. Invert: 1100 1010. Add 1: 1100 1011. (It asks for the two's complement, not the representation, so it is the negative.)

cards.tz: 求二补码方法一：用 2^N 减
cards.en: For an integer X, N-bit binary of X + N-bit two's complement of X = 2N. So to find the N-bit two's complement, subtract X's N-bit binary representation from 2N (1 followed by N zeros). Every step can be done on a calculator. Equivalently, the unsigned value of −X's pattern is 2N − X.
cards.zh: 对整数 X：X 的 N 位二进制 + X 的 N 位二补码 = 2N。所以用 2N（1 后面 N 个 0）减去 X 的二进制即可，全程可用计算机。

ex.q: Find the 8-bit two's complement of 27<sub>10</sub>.

cards.t: Finding two's complement: invert and add 1
cards.tz: 求二补码方法二：取反加一
cards.en: One's complement = invert all bits (0→1, 1→0). Two's complement = one's complement + 1. Steps: (1) convert X to binary and add leading 0s to N bits; (2) invert all bits; (3) add 1. Shortcut: copy bits from the right up to and including the first 1, then invert the rest.
cards.zh: 一补码就是把所有位取反。二补码 = 一补码 + 1。步骤：(1) 转二进制并补 0 到 N 位；(2) 全部取反；(3) 加 1。捷径：由右边起保留到第一个 1（包括它），左边其余位取反。

ex.q: Find the 8-bit two's complement of 45<sub>10</sub>.
ex.az: 取反后加一。

ex.q: Find the 8-bit two's complement of 101<sub>10</sub>.
What is the 7-bit two's complement of 17?

cards.en: With two's complement, a computer does subtraction by addition: A − B = A + (two's complement of B). Simply add all the representations; if an additional bit (carry out) appears beyond N bits, the computer discards it. Example 38 − 49 + 13 in 8 bits: 0010 0110 + 1100 1111 + 0000 1101 = 1 0000 0010 → discard → 0000 0010 = 2. Benefits: one adder circuit handles both + and −, negative numbers can be represented, and there is only one 0.
cards.zh: 二补码让电脑以加法做减法：A − B = A + (B 的二补码)。直接把各表示相加，超出 N 位的额外位会被丢弃。例如 8 位计 38−49+13 得 0000 0010 = 2。好处：同一个加法电路处理加减、可表示负数、只有一个 0。

ex.q: Calculate 19 − 27 + 4 in 8-bit two's complement.

cards.en: Two older methods: Sign-magnitude: first bit is the sign (0 +, 1 −), the rest is the magnitude (12 = 0000 1100, −12 = 1000 1100). One's complement: a negative is the inverted bits (−12 = 1111 0011). Both are deprecated because (1) simply adding representations gives wrong results, needing extra operations (e.g. 38−49+13 gives −28 in sign-magnitude and 1 in one's complement), and (2) each has two representations of 0 (sign-magnitude 0000 0000 and 1000 0000; one's complement 0000 0000 and 1111 1111), making zero checks inconvenient. Two's complement solves both.
cards.zh: 旧方法：原码 (sign-magnitude)：首位是符号，其余是数值；反码 (one's complement)：负数把所有位取反。两者已被淘汰，因为 (1) 直接相加会得出错误结果，要额外处理；(2) 0 有两种表示，检查是否为 0 不方便。二补码同时解决这两个问题。

ex.q: Give the 8-bit sign-magnitude and one's complement representations of −12.
ex.a:
12 = 0000 1100.
Sign-magnitude: 1000 1100. One's complement: 1111 0011.
ex.az: 原码改首位，反码全部取反。

cards.en: An overflow error occurs when the result of a calculation is out of the range that the number of bits can represent; the stored result is then incorrect. For unsigned 4-bit integers (0–15): 9 + 9 = 1001 + 1001 = 1 0010 → the extra bit is discarded → 0010 = 2 (should be 18). 10 − 12: the leftmost bit borrows from a non-existing bit → 1110 = 14 (should be −2). For unsigned integers, an extra carry bit or a borrow from beyond the leftmost bit means overflow.
cards.zh: 溢出错误：运算结果超出位数可表示的范围，储存的结果会错。4 位无符号（0–15）：9+9 得 1 0010，额外位被丢弃→2（应为 18）；10−12 最左位向不存在的位借位→14（应为 −2）。无符号整数出现额外进位或向外借位，就表示溢出。

ex.q: Assume P, Q, R are 3-bit unsigned with P + Q → R. Which conditions guarantee overflow: (1) P = 7, (2) P > R, (3) P > 3 and Q > 4?
ex.a:
(1) No: 7 + 0 = 7 is fine. (2) Yes: adding a non-negative number can only make the true sum ≥ P, so R < P means wrap-around. (3) Yes: P+Q ≥ 4+5 = 9 > 7.
Answer: (2) and (3).
ex.az: (1) Q=0 时不溢出；(2)(3) 必定溢出。

cards.en: For N-bit two's complement (4 bits: −8 to 7), overflow can only happen in two cases: positive + positive gives a negative result, or negative + negative gives a positive result. E.g. 3 + 5 = 0011 + 0101 = 1000 = −8 (should be 8); −4 + (−6) = 1100 + 1010 = 1 0110 → 0110 = 6 (should be −10). Adding two numbers of different signs never overflows. Misconception: an extra carry bit in two's complement does NOT necessarily mean overflow (e.g. 38 − 49 + 13). The fundamental reason is the result being out of range. Also check intermediate results: in 3 + 4 + 2 − 2 (4-bit), 7 + 2 = 9 overflows even though the final answer 7 is in range.
cards.zh: N 位二补码只会在两种情况溢出：正+正得负，或负+负得正。例：3+5=1000=−8；−4+(−6) 得 0110=6。异号相加永不溢出。误解：二补码出现额外进位不一定是溢出，根本原因是结果超出范围。也要检查中间结果：4 位计 3+4+2−2，7+2=9 已溢出。

ex.a:
(1) 92 + 47 = 139 > 127 → overflow (result 10001011 is negative).
(2) −38 + (−5) = −43 → OK.
(3) 121 + (−22) = 99 → different signs, OK.
Answer: (1) only.
ex.az: 只有 (1) 正+正得负。

ex.q: To compute 57 − 298 correctly in two's complement, what is the minimum number of bits?
ex.a: Values involved: 57, 298 (or −298) and −241. Need range to include 298 if it is stored as +298 then negated: 9 bits gives −256..255 (298 out of range); 10 bits gives −512..511. Answer: 10 bits.
ex.az: 298 要 10 位二补码（−512 至 511）才放得下。

cards.en: A character encoding system is a method of representing characters as binary codes. ASCII (American Standard Code for Information Interchange) is a common encoding system for English. It usually uses 7 bits per character, so it can represent 27 = 128 characters, of which 95 are printable (English letters, digits, symbols, space). ASCII is sometimes extended to 8 bits (1 byte) because (1) the extra bit can represent more characters, (2) the extra bit can be used as a parity bit, or (3) some systems process data in bytes. Because each character is very small, ASCII is still used today.
cards.zh: 字符编码系统是以二进制码表示字符的方法。ASCII 是常用的英文编码，通常每字符 7 bits，可表示 128 个字符，其中 95 个可打印。有时扩展至 8 bits（1 byte），原因：(1) 多一位可表示更多字符；(2) 可作奇偶校验位 (parity bit)；(3) 有些系统以 byte 为单位处理数据。因为体积小，ASCII 至今仍在使用。

ex.q: A plain text file has 2,000 ASCII characters stored in 8-bit ASCII. File size in KB?
ex.az: 每字符 1 byte，2000 B ≈ 1.95 KB。

cards.en: You need not memorise every code, but know the structure: space = 32, '0' = 48, 'A' = 65, 'a' = 97. Digits are arranged in ascending order and uppercase and lowercase letters are each in alphabetical order. So code('E') = 65 + 4 = 69, and a lowercase letter's code is its uppercase code + 32 (one bit differs: 1000001 'A' vs 1100001 'a'). Comparisons of strings use these codes, so 'Z' (90) < 'a' (97) and '9' (57) < 'A' (65).
cards.zh: 不用背全部编码，但要知道结构：空格 32，'0' 48，'A' 65，'a' 97。数字按升序排列，大写、小写字母各自按字母顺序。所以 'E' = 69，小写 = 大写 + 32。字符串比较依据这些编码，因此 'Z'(90) < 'a'(97)，'9' < 'A'。

ex.q: Given 'A' = 1000001<sub>2</sub>, find the 7-bit ASCII code of 'G' and 'g'.
ex.az: 按字母顺序推算，小写加 32。

cards.tz: 中文编码：Big-5 与国标码
cards.en: There are far more Chinese characters than English letters: about 4762 commonly used characters need at least ⌈log24762⌉ = 13 bits. Traditional Chinese is often encoded by Big-5 code; Simplified Chinese by Guobiao (GB) code. Both use 2 bytes (16 bits) per character and contain over 10,000 characters, including English letters, digits and symbols. They are not interchangeable: a file encoded in Big-5 but decoded as GB shows garbled text (乱码), not simplified characters. Even a character with no simplified form (e.g. 系) has different codes in Big-5 and GB. Encoding systems can be extended, so some (not all) versions of GB also support traditional Chinese.
cards.zh: 常用中文字约 4762 个，至少需 13 bits。繁体中文常用 Big-5，简体中文常用国标码 (GB)。两者每字 2 bytes，收录逾 10,000 字，也包括英文字母、数字和符号。两者不能互通：Big-5 档案用 GB 解码会出现乱码，不会自动变简体。即使没有简体写法的字（如「系」）在两者的编码也不同。部分新版 GB 也支援繁体。

ex.q: How many bytes are needed for the string '3D printer' if a device uses 16 bits per character?
ex.a: It is a text string, so '3' is a character. 10 characters (including the space) × 2 bytes = 20 bytes.
ex.az: 共 10 个字符（含空格），每个 2 bytes，20 bytes。

cards.en: When multiple languages (e.g. French and Japanese) appear in one file or website, ASCII, Big-5 and GB cannot represent all the characters, so Unicode is used. Unicode is made to represent all existing languages and currently has more than 100,000 characters (theoretically extendable to about 1,000,000). It may use up to 4 bytes per character but uses variable-width encoding (e.g. UTF-8, UTF-16), so a character takes 1 to 4 bytes depending on the language. Summary: ASCII 7 bits–1 byte (English); Big-5 / GB 2 bytes; Unicode 1–4 bytes (most languages). Advantage: supports many languages, avoids garbled text. Disadvantage: may take more storage than ASCII/Big-5 for some characters (e.g. Chinese in UTF-8 uses 3 bytes).
cards.zh: 当档案或网站有多种语言时要用 Unicode。它为表示所有语言而设，现有逾 100,000 字符，理论上可扩展到约 1,000,000。最多用 4 bytes，但采用可变长度编码 (UTF-8、UTF-16)，每字符 1–4 bytes。优点：支援多语言、避免乱码；缺点：某些字符占用空间较大（如 UTF-8 中文 3 bytes）。误解：Unicode 每个字符都用 4 bytes，错。

ex.q: Which encoding should be used for an article containing Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Spanish and French? Why?
ex.a: Unicode, because it supports characters of most languages in one file; Big-5 cannot represent Japanese kana and some accented letters.
ex.az: Unicode 可同时表示多种语言。

ex.q: In UTF-8, how many bytes is 'Hi你好'?
ex.a: 'H','i' 1 byte each; '你','好' 3 bytes each → 1+1+3+3 = 8 bytes.
ex.az: 英文 1 byte，中文 3 bytes，共 8 bytes。

cards.en: Barcodes are codes consisting of bars and spaces of different widths that represent a text string, often a sequence of numbers such as a product ID. Compared with manually typing, barcode scanning reduces typing errors and input time. Elements: barcode symbol (main part, decoded into characters); quiet zone (empty margin at each end; too small → hard to scan); start and end characters (mark start and end of the symbol); text string under the bars (optional, for humans; scanners do not read it). The scanner reads along a line, so only the widths of bars and spaces matter, not the heights. A readable barcode must keep sufficient quiet zone and unchanged bar/space widths.
cards.zh: 条码由不同宽度的线条和空位组成，代表一串文字，通常是产品编号。与人手输入相比，减少输入错误及时间。组成：条码符号、静区 (quiet zone)（两端空白，太窄难以扫描）、开始及结束字符、下方文字（给人看，扫描器不读）。扫描器只读一条线，只有线条和空位的宽度重要，高度不重要。

ex.q: A supermarket scans product barcodes at checkout to update stock. What does the barcode represent and give two benefits.
ex.a:
It represents the product ID.
Benefits: faster input than typing; fewer input errors; stock records updated automatically and accurately.
ex.az: 代表产品编号；好处：快、准确、自动更新存货。

cards.en: A Quick Response (QR) code is a two-dimensional barcode made of black dots on a white square background. It usually represents a URL, phone number or email address. Elements: quiet zone around all four sides; position patterns at three of the four corners, which allow scanning from any direction; alignment pattern, which lets the scanner fix distortion when scanned at an angle. QR codes can still be read when rotated, distorted, dirtied, coloured or partly covered by a logo, because of error correction.
cards.zh: QR code 是二维条码，由白色方形背景上的黑点组成，常代表网址、电话或电邮。组成：四边都有静区；三个角的定位图案 (position pattern) 令它可从任何方向扫描；校正图案 (alignment pattern) 让扫描器在斜角时修正变形。旋转、变形、弄脏、加 logo 仍可读取。

ex.q: A poster needs a link to a website. Barcode or QR code? Explain.
ex.a: QR code: it can store a long URL with Unicode characters (barcodes hold ~50 characters, often numbers only), and it can be scanned from any direction with a phone.
ex.az: QR code 可存较长网址，任何方向都能扫。

cards.tz: 条码与 QR code 比较
cards.en:
AttributeBarcodeQR code
Easiness to scanNormally only from two angles, 0° or 180°From any direction; may still read when the scanner is at an angle
Error correctionCannot be scanned if the width of a single bar/space is alteredHigher; can often restore up to 30% of data
Character setASCII characters, or numbers onlyUnicode characters
Character limitAround 50At least 1000
Both can be scanned by a smartphone with suitable apps.
cards.zh: 比较：扫描方向：条码只能 0° 或 180°，QR 可任何方向；纠错能力：条码一条线宽度改变就读不到，QR 可还原最多 30% 数据；字符集：条码 ASCII 或只有数字，QR 支援 Unicode；字符上限：条码约 50，QR 至少 1000。两者都可用手机 app 扫描。

ex.q: Which statements about a QR code are correct? (1) cannot represent numbers (2) can be scanned in any direction (3) may be decoded with a logo added in its centre
ex.a: (1) wrong: QR codes can represent any characters. (2) correct. (3) correct: up to 30% can be restored. Answer: (2) and (3).

cards.en:
Analog data is represented in a physical way with continuous values, e.g. sound waves, written text, drawings, printed photos, books. Stored on photographic film, cassette tape. Digital data is represented in discrete symbols (like 0 and 1), e.g. text documents, digital photos, audio files, e-books; stored on memory cards, optical discs.
AttributeAnalogDigital
Representationphysical, continuousdiscrete symbols
Lifespan/durability of mediashorter, less durablelonger, more durable
Reduce size by compressionlowhigh
Resistance to corruption in transmission/replicationlowhigh (validation e.g. parity check)
Data analysislow (manual update)high (spreadsheet auto-updates, charts)
cards.zh: 模拟数据以物理、连续方式表示（声波、手写字、画、相片、书），存于菲林、卡式带。数码数据以离散符号（0 和 1）表示（文件、数码相片、音频），存于记忆卡、光碟。数码数据：储存媒体寿命较长、可压缩、传送及复制时较不易损坏（可用 parity check 验证）、较易分析。

ex.q: Classify: (a) a cassette recording (b) an MP3 file (c) a handwritten letter (d) an e-book.
ex.a: Analog: (a), (c). Digital: (b), (d).
ex.az: (a)(c) 模拟，(b)(d) 数码。

cards.en: Digitalisation is the conversion of analog data to digital data. It has two parts: (1) Discretisation: the analog signal is sampled at a regular time interval; the interval determines the sampling rate. (2) Quantisation: the sampled values are rounded to a fixed set of discrete values (e.g. integers), giving a sequence like (30, 49, 64, 70, ...) stored as binary. A higher sampling rate takes more samples per period, so the data is closer to the original waveform with less data loss, but it needs more storage. Digitalisation always loses some information (it is not lossless).
cards.zh: 数码化是把模拟数据转为数码数据，分两步：(1) 离散化：按固定时间间隔取样，间隔决定取样频率；(2) 量化：把取样值四舍五入到固定的离散值（如整数），再以二进制储存。取样频率越高，越接近原波形、数据损失越少，但档案越大。数码化总会有一点数据损失。

ex.q: A signal is sampled at times 0,1,2,3 s giving 29.6, 48.7, 64.2, 69.9. Quantise to integers.
ex.a: Round each: 30, 49, 64, 70. Sampling at fixed times is discretisation; rounding is quantisation.
ex.az: 定时取样是离散化，四舍五入是量化。

cards.t: Digitalisation of text, images, sounds and videos
cards.tz: 文字、图像、声音及影片的数码化
cards.en: Books: a book is scanned by a scanner/scanning app into a digital image; optical character recognition (OCR) can convert the image into editable text. After digitalisation, multimedia can be added, many e-books fit on one device, and text is easy to search. Misconception: OCR alone is NOT digitalisation, because both the image and the e-book are already digital. Text can also be digitalised by typing. Printing an e-book is digital → analog. Sound: sound source → microphone (sound → electricity, analog) → sound card (analog → binary, digital) → storage/editing; playback: speaker → ear (digital → analog). Digital audio is less affected by noise and can be copied without loss. Recording video with a camera is also digitalisation; playing audio/video is digital → analog.
cards.zh: 书本：用扫描器变成数码图像，再用 OCR 转为可编辑文字；之后可加多媒体、一部装置可放很多书、易于搜寻。误解：单独 OCR 不算数码化，因为图像与电子书都已是数码数据；打字也可数码化。打印是数码→模拟。声音：咪高峰把声音变电讯号（模拟），声卡转成二进制（数码）；播放时喇叭再转回模拟。用摄影机录影也是数码化。

ex.q: Which involve analog↔digital conversion? (1) printing an e-document (2) combining images into a video (3) recording a fox's sound

cards.t: File format, file header and extension
cards.tz: 档案格式、档头与扩展名
cards.en: Multimedia can be stored in various file formats. The file format and metadata (e.g. bit depth, sampling rate) are stored in the file header, which helps the computer read and decode the file. The format is usually indicated by the file extension (e.g. Limerick.txt). Renaming the extension does NOT change the file format. To change format properly, export in another format using editing software or use file format converting software. Different formats are supported by different software/OS, and some involve lossy compression, so choose wisely.
cards.zh: 多媒体有多种档案格式。格式与元数据（如位元深度、取样频率）存于档头 (file header)，帮助电脑解读。格式通常由扩展名显示。改扩展名不会改变档案格式；要用编辑软件汇出其他格式，或用格式转换软件。

ex.q: Tom renames photo.bmp to photo.jpg. Is the file now compressed?
ex.a: No. Only the name changed; the data is still BMP (uncompressed). He should export it as JPG with image editing software.
ex.az: 只改名，内容仍是 BMP。

cards.en: Large files take longer to transfer, so multimedia files are often compressed to facilitate transmission and save storage. Details of the compression method are stored in the file header. Lossless compression: no data is lost; the original file can be retrieved completely after decompression. Example idea (run-length style): replace repeated patterns with a count + pattern, e.g. SSSSSS → 6S; use backslashes to enclose patterns containing digits. Common lossless archive formats: ZIP, RAR, 7Z; PNG, GIF, FLAC are lossless media formats.
cards.zh: 大档案传送较慢，所以多媒体常被压缩以加快传送及节省空间。无损压缩：没有数据损失，解压后可完全还原原档。例子：把重复图案写成次数+图案，如 SSSSSS→6S。常见：ZIP、RAR、7Z，以及 PNG、GIF、FLAC。

ex.q: Compress 'AAAABBBCCCCCC' using count+character run-length encoding.
ex.a: 4A3B6C (13 characters → 6). It can be expanded back exactly, so it is lossless. Compression ratio = 13 ÷ 6 ≈ 2.17.
ex.az: 4A3B6C，可完整还原。

cards.en: Lossy compression: some data is lost; the decompressed file is slightly different from the original, but it saves more storage than lossless. Examples: JPG, MP3, AAC, MP4. Compression ratio = Uncompressed size ÷ Compressed size (higher = better compression). E.g. 40 characters → 25 characters: 40 ÷ 25 = 1.6. Compression methods perform best on uncompressed files; compressing an already compressed file saves less space and can even make it larger. Same image: quality BMP = PNG > JPG; file size BMP > PNG > JPG; ratio JPG > PNG. Zipping a BMP saves more than zipping a JPG of the same size.
cards.zh: 有损压缩：会失去部分数据，解压后与原档略有不同，但更省空间（JPG、MP3、MP4）。压缩比 = 未压缩大小 ÷ 压缩后大小。对未压缩档效果最好；压缩已压缩的档案节省很少，甚至会变大。同一图像：质素 BMP = PNG > JPG；大小 BMP > PNG > JPG。

ex.q: A BMP of 1376 KB becomes a 609 KB PNG and a 5 KB JPG. Find the compression ratios.
ex.az: PNG 约 2.26，JPG 约 275。

ex.q: Four 20 MB files A.png, B.jpg, C.wav, D.wmv are zipped. Which zip is smallest normally?
ex.a: C.zip, because WAV is uncompressed; the others are already compressed.
ex.az: 只有 WAV 未压缩，压缩效果最好。

cards.en: Plain text stores characters only. Formatted text stores characters and formatting data (font type, size, colour, line spacing, alignment), so its file size is larger. File size of plain text ≈ size per character × number of characters. A text file format is not tied to any character encoding. A formatted file may look different in different software (formatting interpreted differently; missing fonts replaced). PDF fixes the layout and can embed fonts, solving this.
cards.zh: 纯文字只存字符；格式化文本另存格式资料（字体、大小、颜色、行距、对齐），所以较大。纯文字档大小 ≈ 每字符大小 × 字符数。文字档格式与字符编码无关。格式化档在不同软件可能显示不同（缺字体会被替换），PDF 版面固定、可内嵌字体。

ex.q: A TXT file has 3,000 Chinese characters in Big-5 and 500 ASCII (1-byte) characters. Approx size?

cards.en: Bitmap images are stored as a grid of little squares called pixels; each pixel is assigned a binary number indicating its colour. Scaling up makes them blurry / rough-edged (pixelated). Advantages: real-life digital photos are bitmaps; editable by common software like Paint. Vector images are stored as mathematical formulae connecting points to draw lines, curves, circles, polygons. Advantages: file size tends to be smaller; no rough edges and not blurry when scaled. Good for logos, icons, diagrams; not for photos.
cards.zh: 点阵图由像素 (pixel) 方格组成，每个像素有一个代表颜色的二进制数，放大会模糊、有锯齿；优点：真实相片都是点阵图，一般软件可编辑。向量图以数学公式连接点画出线、曲线、多边形；优点：档案较小、缩放不失真，适合 logo、图示，不适合相片。

ex.q: A school logo will be printed on a pen and on a 5 m banner. Bitmap or vector?
ex.a: Vector (e.g. SVG): it scales to any size without becoming blurry, and the file is small.
ex.az: 向量图缩放不失真。

cards.en: Colour depth is the number of bits used to represent the colour of a pixel. With d bits, a pixel can show 2d colours: 1-bit = 2 (black and white, monochrome); 3-bit = 8; 8-bit = 256; 24-bit ≈ 16.7 million. Higher colour depth → more colours, larger file. GIF always has 8-bit colour depth (256 colours).
cards.zh: 色深是表示一个像素颜色所用的位数。d 位可表示 2d 种颜色：1-bit 黑白，8-bit 256 色，24-bit 约 1670 万色。色深越高颜色越多、档案越大。GIF 一定是 8-bit（256 色）。

ex.q: An image must show 1000 different colours. Minimum colour depth?
ex.az: 要 10 bits。

cards.tz: 解像度、长宽比与透明度
cards.en: Resolution is the total number of pixels, written width × height (e.g. 1600 × 900). Shown at the same size, a higher-resolution image looks less blurry. Aspect ratio is the ratio of width to height (4:3, 16:9, 16:10, 32:9). Changing it without editing gives blank spaces or cropping. Monitors have moved from 4:3 to wider ratios; gamers and streamers like wide screens to see more horizontally. Transparency: whether an image can have transparent areas. White is NOT transparent. A format without transparency (e.g. BMP, JPG) is always a rectangle; PNG supports transparency, so a parrot PNG can be placed on a forest background cleanly.
cards.zh: 解像度是像素总数，写作宽 × 高；同样大小显示时解像度高较清晰。长宽比是宽与高之比（4:3、16:9）；改变长宽比会出现空白或裁切。透明度：能否有透明区域，白色不是透明；不支援透明的格式（BMP、JPG）永远是长方形，PNG 支援透明。

cards.en: File size of an uncompressed bitmap = colour depth × width × height (in bits; ÷8 for bytes, ÷1024 for KB, ÷1024 for MB). Compressed bitmaps and vector images are harder to estimate.

cards.t: Audio: bit depth, sampling rate, channels
cards.tz: 音频：位元深度、取样频率、声道
cards.en: An audio file has three key attributes. Bit depth: number of bits per audio sample; higher → more sound levels, better quality. Sampling rate: number of samples taken per second (Hz); higher → closer to the original wave, better quality. Audio CD = 44,100 Hz; DVD = 96,000 Hz. Number of channels: mono = 1, stereo = 2, 5.1 surround sound = more than two (6).
cards.zh: 音频三属性：位元深度（每个样本的位数，越高可表示越多音量级、音质越好）；取样频率（每秒样本数，CD 为 44,100 Hz，DVD 96,000 Hz）；声道数（单声道 1、立体声 2、5.1 环绕声多于 2）。

ex.q: How many sound levels can a 16-bit sample represent?
ex.a: 216 = 65,536 levels.

cards.en: Uncompressed audio size = bit depth × number of channels × sampling rate × duration (s). Formats: WAV/WAVE uncompressed, high quality, large; MP3, AAC, OGG lossy, small; WMA lossy or lossless; FLAC, ALAC lossless, high quality, relatively large; MIDI uncompressed but small, stores musical note data / sampled sounds, not human voice. To save space on a website, choose MP3. WAV vs MP3: WAV better quality, but much larger.
cards.zh: 未压缩音频大小 = 位元深度 × 声道数 × 取样频率 × 秒数。格式：WAV 未压缩、大；MP3/AAC/OGG 有损、细；WMA 有损或无损；FLAC/ALAC 无损；MIDI 储存音符资料，细，但不能存人声。

ex.q: Audio A: 24-bit, 1 channel, 44,100 Hz, 6 min 40 s. Size in MB?
Audio B: 16-bit, stereo, 96,000 Hz, 2 min 30 s. Size in MB?

cards.t: Video: frame rate, file size and formats
cards.tz: 影片：帧率、档案大小与格式
cards.en: A video is a sequence of images (frames) shown within a duration, possibly with audio tracks. Attributes: colour depth, resolution, frame rate (frames per second, fps; higher → smoother) and duration. Uncompressed size = colour depth × resolution × frame rate × duration + size of audio track. Formats: AVI uncompressed (large); MP4 lossy, codecs MPEG-4, H.264 (AVC) (smaller, most browsers, HD streaming), H.265 (HEVC) (smaller still, better above 2K, few browsers); WebM (VP8) smaller, high compression; WMV, MOV, MKV lossy; FLV lossy or lossless. MP4 vs AVI: MP4 much smaller and good for streaming, but loses some quality.
cards.zh: 影片是一连串图像（帧）加音轨。属性：色深、解像度、帧率 (fps，越高越流畅)、长度。未压缩大小 = 色深 × 解像度 × 帧率 × 秒数 + 音轨大小。格式：AVI 未压缩；MP4 有损（MPEG-4、H.264、H.265）；WebM、WMV、MOV、MKV 有损。
